## Destination

A validated loss model of the opposition bench: P_remaining(f) confirmed (or refuted) as linear over a 10–100 kHz campaign at 60 V / 3.5 A peak / 300 ns dead time, Eoff extracted, and the frequency-independent term characterised, published as a new version of the [Zenodo dataset](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17296030) (data + processing script + short note).

## Resume here

<!-- devmap:resume:start -->
_Map just charted._ Tonight's slice "Ready for 27 November" is the frontier.
<!-- devmap:resume:end -->

## Visual map

<!-- devmap:diagram:start -->
_(drawn by `tools/devmap/devmap.py`)_
<!-- devmap:diagram:end -->

## Notes

- **Domain:** switching-loss measurement by the opposition method (two half-bridges in opposition, SPIN phase shift, DMMs + scopes + Z+ supply, Python supervisor). Origin: the Open-Power session report of 2026-10-13: the next session (2026-11-27) consolidates 10–100 kHz data and confronts it with the loss-breakdown Excel. Analysis so far: P_remaining(f) = 17.43 mW/kHz · f + 3.22 W, Eoff ≈ 4.36 µJ per switch (60 V, 3.5 A peak, 300 ns, 50/60/70 kHz).
- **Code:** work on branch `session-2026-11-27` of this fork, cut from `ReleaseCandidate_OnlyScripts` (Maxime's simplified supervisor). The bench core is branch `power_tuesday-v2` of [luizvilla/Core](https://github.com/luizvilla/Core), from `feature/hrtim-dma-sequences` (upstream main `8111a0dc` + period-synchronised start/stop) with the up-down re-init fix `04f43dc8`; old Zephyr, **not** the 4.4.2 bump. Local worktree `~/code/Core-power-tuesday`. The bench app lives in `firmware/` of this repo, pinned to that core.
- **This map carries execution (override of wayfinder's planning default).** `wayfinder:build` tickets are build units: Unit / Done when / Test. Commits say `Refs #n`; the last one says `Closes #n`. A build ticket closes when its "done when" holds.
- **`wayfinder:luiz`** (👤) marks a ticket that can't move without Luiz: a decision, a powered bench session, a colleague's OK.
- **Claiming:** assign to luizvilla **and** comment "claimed by <Claude|Codex|Luiz>, <date>". Post "stopped at / next step" at every commit. 3 days without a comment, commit or update = stale (⏳).
- **SPOC:** the Spin-alone tests run autonomously on the SPOC bench (reflash through ST-Link, scope verdicts); run the Core2 preflight first and leave the board with the bench firmware.
- **Visual map:** run `python3 tools/devmap/devmap.py` after any ticket opens, closes, is claimed or is blocked; it redraws this body and `docs/map.md`. No GitHub Project for now.
- **Upstream:** issues and PRs on `owntech-foundation/test_bench_code` only with Luiz's go. Always pass `-R luizvilla/test_bench_code` to `gh`.
- **Skills:** `grilling` + `domain-modeling` for HITL tickets, `research` for research, `tdd` for build tickets where a test fits.

## Decisions so far

<!-- one line per closed ticket -->

## Not yet specified

- **Fixed-term characterisation grid:** how the ~3.22 W frequency-independent part varies with bus voltage, dead time and peak current: which grid, how many sessions. Hangs on whether the frequency trend holds.
- **Capacitor vs frequency window:** the electrolytic (125 mΩ ESR) resonates too close to the switching frequencies; change the capacitor, or restrict the window. Hangs on where the sweep shows the resonance biting.
- **Simulation vs bench mismatch** (upstream owntech-foundation/test_bench_code#10) and the bench-vs-simulation protocol (#13): what the LTspice models must explain once the processing script exists.
- **DMM trigger timing at fast plateaus** (upstream #12): matters if the campaign needs shorter plateaus.
- **Zenodo new version:** contents, the note, the processing script's release.
- **Upstreaming:** PRs of `session-2026-11-27` to `owntech-foundation/test_bench_code` and of `power_tuesday-v2` to OwnTech Core, once the session confirms them.
- **ThingSet migration itself**, once the decision says go.

## Out of scope

- A journal / conference paper: the destination stops at the Zenodo version.
- The Zephyr 4.4.2 bump (code/Core) and the Safety API PR (code/Core2): separate maps.
